long_biography.plain_text:
Friedmutter began in modeling and moved through screen acting and radio, developing and hosting In the Heat of the Night on KLSX in Los Angeles. Those public-facing roles eventually gave way to training in hypnotherapy and neuro-linguistic programming. She built a private advisory practice serving clients across entertainment, business and public life, while dividing her time between Nevada and California.

Her 2019 book, Subconscious Power, translated that work into six lessons intended to help readers recognise habitual patterns and make more deliberate choices. Simon & Schuster positioned her as both practitioner and author, and she extended the book through interviews, courses and media appearances. Friedmutter has also served on the UCLA Health System Board. Her career is therefore best understood as a shift from entertainment into a sustained practice built around coaching, communication and self-help education.
